d: India sealed the T20I series 3-0 with a dominant 6-wicket win over New Zealand in the 3rd T20I. Despite Daryl Mitchell’s unbeaten 89 powering New Zealand to 198/3, India chased down 199 in just 13.2 overs, led by Abhishek Sharma’s sensational 113 off 38 balls and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s explosive 45 off 19 balls. India’s record-breaking 118-run powerplay highlighted a spectacular batting performance.
